en: Identify the exact meaning and its governing ontology before choosing a domain code.
Reuse an existing code only when its meaning is identical; new domain concepts require a unique code and a namespace-qualified ontology reference.
Preserve qualifiers such as time, quantity, uncertainty, ownership, negation, and conditions.
Do not guess unknown codes. Use literal text or add a new concept.
Add an example and a round-trip translation test for every new concept.
Embed the required vocabulary or agree on its verified hash before exchanging new codes.
